scene: The open deck of an old steam trawler in a night storm, huge waves, spray and rain across the frame

subjects.description: A young woman with long red braided hair plastered to her face and a soaked dark green wool cloak
subjects.position: left third, gripping a rope railing
subjects.action: shouting toward the wheelhouse, one arm pointing at a wave
subjects.pose: braced wide stance, body leaning into the wind, three-quarter view

subjects.description: A heavy-set grey-bearded captain in a navy peacoat
subjects.position: right, in the lit wheelhouse doorway
subjects.pose: leaning back, both hands on the wheel

style: painterly cinematic concept art, energetic brush strokes, storyboard action frame
lighting: lightning flash as a hard cold key from behind the wave, warm wheelhouse light on the captain, deck lamp swinging
background: a wall of black water, foam, the bow dipping, a lifebuoy swinging on its hook
composition: dutch angle tilted 15 degrees, diagonal of the deck against the wave crest

camera.angle: low angle from the deck, tilted
camera.depth_of_field: deep, spray drops in the foreground
